d: literally: to be behind (a person or deity); hence: = state in which humans are loyal to a leader or deity
action wherby deities act with {L:loyalty<SDBH:חֶסֶד>}

state in which humans or deities are committed towards fulfilling their obligations and show that by their actions; these obligations include responsibilities towards kinspeople, spouses, friends, covenant partners, and people to whom one is indebted as a result of favors received

someone who practices חֶסֶד, who is committed towards fulfilling his/her obligations; these may be obligations defined within the context of a covenant or agreement, or moral obligations to do well to someone who did well to you before
literally: behind; hence: = a state in which humans are committed to follow the leadership and example of other humans or deities
person whose behavior is morally and ethically right
literally: to be established; hence: = state in which someone's {L:heart<SDBH:לֵב>} or {L:spirit<SDBH:רוּחַ>} is committed to following the will of God
something about which one cannot be sure that it is there when one looks for it
state in which a town is committed to fulfilling its obligations to the nation of which it is a part; ◄ here compared to a mother, who is considered a loyal and responsible part of a family
state in which humans are considered worthy of trust, because they are truthful and committed, with an unwavering disposition, which is reflected in their actions
state in which humans and deities are considered worthy of trust, because they are truthful and committed, with an unwavering disposition, which is reflected in their actions
state in which humans and deities are considered worthy of trust, because they are truthful and committed, with an unwavering disposition, which is reflected in their words and actions
state in which humans and deities are considered worthy of trust, because they are truthful and committed, with an unwavering disposition, which is reflected in their words and actions
literally: to give (someone) a complete heart; hence: = causative action or process by which which deities cause humans to be fully committed to a deity or a certain activity
state in which a deity is considered worthy of trust, because he is truthful and committed, with an unwavering disposition, which is reflected in his actions
state in which deities are considered worthy of trust, because they are truthful and committed, with an unwavering disposition, which is reflected in their actions
state in which humans and deities are considered worthy of trust, because they are truthful and committed, with an unwavering disposition, which is reflected in their words and actions
literally: to endure; hence: = state in which humans stand by a certain principle
literally: (one's) heart is complete; hence: = state in which humans are fully committed to a deity or a certain activity
